PG1.quote: Startup, eager loading and the test run all fail with `LoadError: cannot load such file -- pagy/extras/items` ... The notes list cannot render, because `Pagy#items` was renamed to `#limit` in 9.0.0 ... require "pagy/extras/limit" ... Pagy::DEFAULT[:limit] = 10 / Pagy::DEFAULT[:limit_param] = :per_page / Pagy::DEFAULT[:limit_max] = 50 ... change ... `@pagy.items` to ... `@pagy.limit`
PG1.reasons: Validation: the plan relies on the suite passing, a printout of the settings, the per_page=500 cap and the selected-option check. It leaves out the key's scenario: asymmetric owned, filter-excluded and foreign notes; page 2 at size 5 showing positions 6–10; following the actual Next href to positions 11–15; the last page at size 25; the exact filter queries kept in links; /journal; empty search; the foreign-note 404; and the anonymous redirect.

PG2.quote: `GET /notes?page=0` (and `page=-1`, `page=two` or `page=`) now raises `Pagy::VariableError` ... which is a 500 error in production. On 8.6.3 these requests show page 1. ... The repair below also works on 8.6.3 (confirmed by probe), so it can be deployed before the bump.
PG2.reasons: Validation: the content comparison against page one, done with 52 records, covers only "0", "-1" and "two". The blank page was checked only in a probe with zero records. The checks include no valid first or next page controls and no filtering or ownership controls. The patch was checked on the baseline only by a zero-record probe, not by a content-level run on 8.6.3.
